notes.title: Update information until August 17, 2025

notes.title: About game release
notes.notes:
Regarding the release of Ortho Blaze,
because the volume of the scenario turned out to be much larger than originally planned
[u][i]we have decided to change the structure of the game to two parts and develop it in two parts.[/i][/u]

With that in mind, [u][i]the Japanese version of the game will be released in August 2025.[/i][/u]
Ortho Blaze scheduled for release this time will be the first part, and then we will start developing the new work, the second part.

We will update languages ​​other than Japanese as soon as they are available,
so [u][i]please check the language support status of the store when purchasing.[/i][/u]

We apologize to those who are looking forward to the release and those who are interested in the game
for the confusing release content.

We are currently working hard on development towards the game's release,
so we would appreciate your continued support.

thank you.
